description: Add a track returned by search to one of your editable collections. A collection has at most 500 tracks. A CC BY-NC track cannot be added to a commercial collection; use another track or mark the collection not commercial.

revision.description: Current collection revision when coordinating concurrent edits.

name: add_to_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Add a track to a collection
